articles.title: LANTERNS Showrunner Says Batman Mention Required “Shockingly Fewer Conversations” Than You’d Think
articles.summary: The HBO series "Lanterns," in its sixth episode, subtly confirmed Batman's official existence within the live-action DCU. This revelation was made without a grand announcement, simply establishing his presence in the fictional universe, rather than a massive reveal.

articles.title: Trump and Xi: Strongmen at the Temple of Thymos
articles.summary: In May 2026, U.S. President Donald Trump made his second state visit to China, escorted by President Xi Jinping through Beijing's historic Temple of Heaven. This significant diplomatic event between the two global powers likely involved high-level discussions on bilateral relations, trade, and geopolitical issues, underscoring complex international power dynamics and strategic alliances.
